name: spy-mouse-web
description: A web port of Spy Mouse (canvas + ES modules).

scripts.build: node tools/import-assets.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/walkmask.ps1 && node tools/patch-masks.mjs && node tools/add-floor-faces.mjs && node tools/carve-entities.mjs && node tools/carve-approach-masks.mjs && node tools/import-entities.mjs && node tools/import-collision.mjs && node tools/import-collision.mjs --doorway-gaps --only=map736,map555,map565,map556,map568,map531,map816,map575 && node tools/fix-boss-entrances.mjs && node tools/import-player-animations.mjs && node tools/import-ui.mjs && node tools/import-menu.mjs && npm run mechanisms && npm run audio
scripts.test: node tools/test-levels.mjs && node tools/test-repairs.mjs && node tools/test-mechanisms.mjs && node tools/test-boss-flow.mjs && node tools/test-bonus.mjs && node tools/verify-platforms.mjs && node tools/verify-tv.mjs && node tools/audit-entrances.mjs && node tools/audit-boss-approach.mjs --strict --quiet && node tools/verify-audio.mjs
scripts.mechanisms: node tools/import-mechanisms.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/walkmask.ps1 -MapsDir assets/floors/backgrounds -OutDir assets/floors/masks -Individual
